name: Vicky Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, Vicky Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 80 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 34*, with an average of 12.03 and a quick strike rate of 97.26. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 38 sixes and 56 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 9.3 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 9.68. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
